style: Narrate as a literary thriller for one attentive listener. Keep the voice close and human. Shape each sentence with natural rises and falls, vary pace as the thought develops, and let key phrases land. Use subtle unease and lightly differentiated quoted speech. Engaged but restrained, never flat, announcer-like, or theatrical.

variants.text: Adrian had written about this. He had, in fact, written compulsively about this — as if the writing could retroactively justify the years of fighting a tide he was never going to turn. He'd watched the generation of entrepreneurs who replaced him and saw a class corrupted beyond recovery, drunk on the power these systems gave them, blind to what that power was doing. He couldn't change them. He'd tried, and they'd shown him the door with a severance package and a polite suggestion that he "pursue his passion for education."
